known.title: The new list-split rows of delimitedParts have no test that runs them through transcripts
known.summary: The delta adds list-split rows in LIST_SPLITS (score.mjs:73-78) that delimitedParts uses (score.mjs:1929-1947): the `;` split that needs no part to exist, the white-space split, the split on all three delimiters, and the URI list on `;`. No test runs these rows through transcriptsCommand. The new transcripts test (review-benchmark.test.mjs:4936-4986) covers only the `,` split and targets that stay one path, and the readScope test gives a hand-built `lists` map. So a change that removes the white-space row or the all-three row, or makes the `;` row need existing parts, fails no test, and a grep path `<snapshot>/src <live>/src` then counts as one allowed path. Plan step 9 (line 88) asks for unit tests that show a run invalid for a read under the live checkout.
